text:
Blood draw was painless. No waiting 🙏. Easy parking... It's a petrol station and rest stop plaza.

However... asking me to take off my shoes for hygiene reasons.. Which I support... and then directing me for a urine sample... Outside.. In a public toilet.. Is beyond stupid and incomprehensible.

I paid 3,500 THB for blood and urine tests and I expect a professional office. Using a gasoline stations public toilet for urine collection is very inconvenient, awkward, embarrassing and absolutely not sanitary!!  The Chang Klan office has a clean toilet.. But now closed.
Every year, for the past 11 years, I get my health checked in Thailand. I've never encountered such negligence. 🙏
